content.comment_body: Good morning, I connected a PT100 sensor to my new [product_name] [article_no]. On the device screen, the temperature displays accurately from -50°C to +200°C. However, when viewing in [product_name], it only shows positive temperatures; in freezing conditions, the reading gives an incorrect value like 6545.4. I have attached a screenshot of [product_name]—hopefully someone has experienced this and can share a solution. Kind regards, [user_name]
Check the properties of the value in [product_name] and switch from unsigned to signed integer for proper readings. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you! Your suggestion solved my issue. I can now view accurate temperature readings. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members identified a problem where [product_name] only displayed positive temperatures, showing inaccurate readings for negative values such as 6545.4 in cold conditions. The connected [product_name] module accurately read all values locally, but incorrect integer type settings in [product_name] caused remote display issues. Changing the setting from unsigned to signed integer resolved the situation, allowing the user to monitor both positive and negative temperatures reliably.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect accurate and consistent temperature readings, including negative values, when viewing both directly on their [product_name] device and remotely via [product_name].
